tagline: Myths, stories and music of the Davao Region
brief: An editorial e-magazine featuring Ata Manobo, Bagobo-Tagabawa, Mandaya, Mansaka and Obo Manuvu. The identity should make the five distinct homelands visible without suggesting a single shared culture or borrowing community-specific symbols.
criteria: A distinctive, simple mark that stays readable at small sizes, works in one colour, and respects the distinct identities of the five featured communities.

concepts.name: Five Homelands
concepts.idea: Five independent contour strokes evoke the five featured homelands.
rationale: Uses the exact smooth-wave direction selected by the user.
The separate strokes avoid merging the communities into one cultural symbol.
Forest Night and Turmeric carry the site's existing visual identity into the logo.

recommendation: Five Homelands is the selected direction. Its simple, separate strokes work in monochrome and extend naturally into the magazine's existing palette.
